# Piecewise Weibull data generation
H_weibull <- function(t, shape, scale) {
  (pmax(as.numeric(t), 0) / scale)^shape
}

qH_weibull <- function(z, shape, scale) {
  scale * pmax(as.numeric(z), 0)^(1 / shape)
}

S_piecewise_weibull_monotone <- function(t, shape_pre, scale_pre, shape_post, scale_post, c = 1) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  Hc <- H_weibull(c, shape_pre, scale_pre)
  H <- ifelse(
    t <= c,
    H_weibull(t, shape_pre, scale_pre),
    Hc + H_weibull(t, shape_post, scale_post) - H_weibull(c, shape_post, scale_post)
  )
  exp(-pmax(H, 0))
}

r_piecewise_weibull_monotone <- function(n, shape_pre, scale_pre, shape_post, scale_post, c = 1) {
  z <- rexp(n)
  Hc <- H_weibull(c, shape_pre, scale_pre)
  out <- numeric(n)
  pre <- z <= Hc
  if (any(pre)) out[pre] <- qH_weibull(z[pre], shape_pre, scale_pre)
  if (any(!pre)) {
    target <- H_weibull(c, shape_post, scale_post) + z[!pre] - Hc
    out[!pre] <- qH_weibull(target, shape_post, scale_post)
  }
  out
}

make_weibull_h0_scenarios <- function(hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
                                       null_mode = c("equal", "worse")) {
  hazard_pattern <- match.arg(hazard_pattern)
  null_mode <- match.arg(null_mode)
  rec_values <- c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5)

  if (hazard_pattern == "stable") {
    base <- data.frame(scale = c(4.8, 5.4, 6.0, 6.6, 7.2, 7.8), post_factor = 1)
  } else {
    base <- expand.grid(
      scale = c(5.0, 6.2, 7.4),
      post_factor = if (hazard_pattern == "increasing") c(0.95, 0.85) else c(1.05, 1.15),
      KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
    )
  }

  tab <- base[rep(seq_len(nrow(base)), each = length(rec_values)), , drop = FALSE]
  tab$rec <- rep(rec_values, times = nrow(base))
  tab$scenario_id <- seq_len(nrow(tab))
  shape <- switch(hazard_pattern, increasing = 1.35, decreasing = 0.75, stable = 1.00)
  tab$c_shape_pre <- shape
  tab$c_shape_post <- shape
  tab$c_scale_pre <- tab$scale
  tab$c_scale_post <- tab$scale * tab$post_factor
  worse_hr <- if (null_mode == "worse") 1.25 else 1
  tab$t_shape_pre <- shape
  tab$t_shape_post <- shape
  tab$t_scale_pre <- tab$c_scale_pre / worse_hr^(1 / shape)
  tab$t_scale_post <- tab$c_scale_post / worse_hr^(1 / shape)
  tab
}

run_weibull_h0_family <- function(extrap_dist, hazard_pattern, null_mode, family_seed,
                                  num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  tab <- make_weibull_h0_scenarios(hazard_pattern, null_mode)
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    set.seed(family_seed + j - 1L)
    r <- tab[j, , drop = FALSE]
    cpt <- 1
    gen_c <- function(n) r_piecewise_weibull_monotone(
      n, r$c_shape_pre[[1]], r$c_scale_pre[[1]], r$c_shape_post[[1]], r$c_scale_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    gen_t <- function(n) r_piecewise_weibull_monotone(
      n, r$t_shape_pre[[1]], r$t_scale_pre[[1]], r$t_shape_post[[1]], r$t_scale_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    S_c <- function(t) S_piecewise_weibull_monotone(
      t, r$c_shape_pre[[1]], r$c_scale_pre[[1]], r$c_shape_post[[1]], r$c_scale_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    S_t <- function(t) S_piecewise_weibull_monotone(
      t, r$t_shape_pre[[1]], r$t_scale_pre[[1]], r$t_shape_post[[1]], r$t_scale_post[[1]], cpt
    )

    sav1 <- simu(
      type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.10, rate1 = 0.60, rate2 = 0.40,
      c_shape_pre = r$c_shape_pre[[1]], c_shape_post = r$c_shape_post[[1]],
      c_scale_pre = r$c_scale_pre[[1]], c_scale_post = r$c_scale_post[[1]],
      t_shape_pre = r$t_shape_pre[[1]], t_shape_post = r$t_shape_post[[1]],
      t_scale_pre = r$t_scale_pre[[1]], t_scale_post = r$t_scale_post[[1]],
      change1 = cpt, change2 = cpt, rec = r$rec[[1]], CL = 0.2, CU = 0.90,
      num_simulations = num_simulations, extrap_dist = extrap_dist,
      event_generator_control = gen_c, event_generator_treatment = gen_t,
      S_control_override = S_c, S_treatment_override = S_t
    )
    if (!is.null(sav1) && nrow(sav1) > 0) {
      sav1$type <- paste0(
        "PiecewiseWeibull_H0_",
        if (null_mode == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl_" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl_",
        hazard_pattern, "_", sprintf("%02d", j)
      )
      final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
      if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
    }
  }
  final_sav
}

# Piecewise log-normal data generation
piecewise_lognormal_change <- 1

S_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  out <- rep(1, length(t))
  pos <- t > 0
  if (any(pos)) out[pos] <- plnorm(t[pos], meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog, lower.tail = FALSE)
  pmin(pmax(out, 0), 1)
}

H_lognormal_segment <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog) {
  -log(pmax(S_lognormal_segment(t, meanlog, sdlog), 1e-15))
}

qH_lognormal_segment <- function(z, meanlog, sdlog) {
  p <- 1 - exp(-pmax(as.numeric(z), 0))
  qlnorm(pmin(pmax(p, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12), meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog)
}

r_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier <- function(n, meanlog, sdlog, mult_pre = 1, mult_post = 1,
                                             c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  z <- rexp(n)
  Hc <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog, sdlog)
  zc <- mult_pre * Hc
  out <- numeric(n)
  pre <- z <= zc
  if (any(pre)) out[pre] <- qH_lognormal_segment(z[pre] / mult_pre, meanlog, sdlog)
  if (any(!pre)) {
    target <- Hc + (z[!pre] - zc) / mult_post
    out[!pre] <- qH_lognormal_segment(target, meanlog, sdlog)
  }
  out
}

S_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier <- function(t, meanlog, sdlog, mult_pre = 1, mult_post = 1,
                                             c = piecewise_lognormal_change) {
  t <- pmax(as.numeric(t), 0)
  Hc <- H_lognormal_segment(c, meanlog, sdlog)
  H <- numeric(length(t))
  pre <- t <= c
  if (any(pre)) H[pre] <- mult_pre * H_lognormal_segment(t[pre], meanlog, sdlog)
  if (any(!pre)) {
    H[!pre] <- mult_pre * Hc +
      mult_post * (H_lognormal_segment(t[!pre], meanlog, sdlog) - Hc)
  }
  exp(-pmax(H, 0))
}

make_lognormal_h0_scenarios <- function(hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
                                        null_mode = c("equal", "worse")) {
  hazard_pattern <- match.arg(hazard_pattern)
  null_mode <- match.arg(null_mode)
  rec_values <- c(3.5, 4.5, 5.5)
  base <- expand.grid(
    median = c(3.8, 4.8, 5.8),
    sdlog = c(0.65, 0.80),
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
  )
  tab <- base[rep(seq_len(nrow(base)), each = length(rec_values)), , drop = FALSE]
  tab$rec <- rep(rec_values, times = nrow(base))
  tab$scenario_id <- seq_len(nrow(tab))
  tab$c_meanlog_pre <- log(tab$median)
  tab$c_sdlog_pre <- tab$sdlog
  tab$c_meanlog_post <- tab$c_meanlog_pre
  tab$c_sdlog_post <- tab$c_sdlog_pre
  mult <- switch(
    hazard_pattern,
    increasing = c(0.85, 1.15),
    decreasing = c(1.15, 0.85),
    stable = c(1.00, 1.00)
  )
  tab$c_hr_pre <- mult[1]
  tab$c_hr_post <- mult[2]
  worse_factor <- if (null_mode == "worse") 1.25 else 1
  tab$t_hr_pre <- tab$c_hr_pre * worse_factor
  tab$t_hr_post <- tab$c_hr_post * worse_factor
  tab
}

run_lognormal_h0_family <- function(extrap_dist, hazard_pattern, null_mode, family_seed,
                                    num_simulations = 1000, checkpoint_file = NULL) {
  tab <- make_lognormal_h0_scenarios(hazard_pattern, null_mode)
  final_sav <- data.frame()
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    set.seed(family_seed + j - 1L)
    r <- tab[j, , drop = FALSE]
    cpt <- piecewise_lognormal_change
    gen_c <- function(n) r_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier(
      n, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    gen_t <- function(n) r_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier(
      n, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    S_c <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier(
      t, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_pre[[1]], r$c_hr_post[[1]], cpt
    )
    S_t <- function(t) S_lognormal_piecewise_multiplier(
      t, r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]], r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_pre[[1]], r$t_hr_post[[1]], cpt
    )

    sav1 <- simu(
      type = "Unblinded", alpha = 0.05, beta = 0.10, rate1 = 0.60, rate2 = 0.40,
      c_shape_pre = NA_real_, c_shape_post = NA_real_,
      c_scale_pre = NA_real_, c_scale_post = NA_real_,
      t_shape_pre = NA_real_, t_shape_post = NA_real_,
      t_scale_pre = NA_real_, t_scale_post = NA_real_,
      change1 = cpt, change2 = cpt, rec = r$rec[[1]], CL = 0.2, CU = 0.90,
      num_simulations = num_simulations, extrap_dist = extrap_dist,
      event_generator_control = gen_c, event_generator_treatment = gen_t,
      S_control_override = S_c, S_treatment_override = S_t
    )
    if (!is.null(sav1) && nrow(sav1) > 0) {
      sav1$type <- paste0(
        "PiecewiseLogNormal_H0_",
        if (null_mode == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl_" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl_",
        hazard_pattern, "_", sprintf("%02d", j)
      )
      sav1$c_shape_pre <- r$c_meanlog_pre[[1]]
      sav1$c_shape_post <- r$c_meanlog_post[[1]]
      sav1$c_scale_pre <- r$c_sdlog_pre[[1]]
      sav1$c_scale_post <- r$c_sdlog_post[[1]]
      sav1$t_shape_pre <- r$t_hr_pre[[1]] / r$c_hr_pre[[1]]
      sav1$t_shape_post <- r$t_hr_post[[1]] / r$c_hr_post[[1]]
      sav1$t_scale_pre <- NA_real_
      sav1$t_scale_post <- NA_real_
      final_sav <- rbind(final_sav, sav1)
      if (!is.null(checkpoint_file)) save_result_file(final_sav, checkpoint_file, result_headers)
    }
  }
  final_sav
}

# Twelve H0 output families
h0_output_definitions <- expand.grid(
  distribution = c("PiecewiseWeibull", "PiecewiseLogNormal"),
  hazard_pattern = c("increasing", "decreasing", "stable"),
  null_mode = c("equal", "worse"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
h0_output_definitions$seed <- 21000000L + seq_len(nrow(h0_output_definitions)) * 10000L

run_all_h0_outputs <- function() {
  jobs <- expand.grid(
    method_key = names(extrapolation_methods),
    output_index = seq_len(nrow(h0_output_definitions)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  run_one_job <- function(k) {
    method_key <- jobs$method_key[[k]]
    j <- jobs$output_index[[k]]
    method_label <- unname(extrapolation_methods[method_key])
    d0 <- h0_output_definitions[j, , drop = FALSE]
    null_label <- if (d0$null_mode[[1]] == "equal") "TreatmentEqualControl" else "TreatmentWorseThanControl"
    file_stub <- paste("H0_Unblinded", null_label, d0$distribution[[1]], d0$hazard_pattern[[1]], sep = "_")
    file_path <- file.path(directory_path, paste0(file_stub, "_", method_label, ".xlsx"))

    ans <- if (d0$distribution[[1]] == "PiecewiseWeibull") {
      run_weibull_h0_family(
        method_key, d0$hazard_pattern[[1]], d0$null_mode[[1]], d0$seed[[1]],
        num_simulations_per_scenario, file_path
      )
    } else {
      run_lognormal_h0_family(
        method_key, d0$hazard_pattern[[1]], d0$null_mode[[1]], d0$seed[[1]],
        num_simulations_per_scenario, file_path
      )
    }
    save_result_file(ans, file_path, result_headers)
    file_path
  }

  n_workers <- min(max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)), nrow(jobs))
  if (n_workers <= 1L) {
    generated_files <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), run_one_job)
  } else if (.Platform$OS.type != "windows") {
    generated_files <- parallel::mclapply(
      seq_len(nrow(jobs)), run_one_job, mc.cores = n_workers, mc.preschedule = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_workers)
    on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages({
        library(openxlsx)
        library(survival)
        library(stats)
        library(dplyr)
        library(gsDesign)
        library(flexsurv)
      })
      compiler::enableJIT(3)
      NULL
    })
    export_names <- setdiff(ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, all.names = TRUE), "cl")
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, varlist = export_names, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("jobs", "run_one_job"), envir = environment())
    generated_files <- parallel::parLapply(cl, seq_len(nrow(jobs)), run_one_job)
  }
  invisible(generated_files)
}

run_all_h0_outputs()
